description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandToExceptionRegistry' that provides the foundation for registries mapping commands to their corresponding exceptions, includes logic for fallback handling, and manages mapping strategies.

classes.name: AbstractCommandToExceptionRegistry
classes.description: An abstract class providing the mechanism to map commands to exceptions with fallback handling.

methods.name: AbstractCommandToExceptionRegistry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the registry with a map of strategies.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback behavior by throwing an IllegalArgumentException when no mapping is found.

methods.description: Retrieves the exception corresponding to a command using the mapping strategies or fallback if none found.
